Nami Foundation provides integrated digital solutions for resale in website design And mobile applications. We resell upgraded products with the highest quality standards to meet your needs.

We excel in building advanced and responsive websites that reflect your brand identity and help you communicate effectively with your audience. From design to implementation, we are committed to delivering an exceptional digital experience.

We provide comprehensive solutions for developing mobile applications on both Android and iOS platforms, with a focus on performance and optimal user experience to ensure your apps achieve widespread success.
We help you reach your target audience through advanced digital marketing strategies, including search engine optimization (SEO), social media marketing, and pay-per-click (PPC) advertising.
We offer specialized technical consulting to help you choose and implement the best technological solutions that meet your business needs and drive digital success.

We provide innovative cloud services that enable you to scale your business easily and securely. From cloud hosting to comprehensive cloud solutions, we are here to support your digital transformation.

We offer a comprehensive range of design services that include graphic design and brand identity design. We work to create innovative designs that reflect the essence of your brand and attract the attention of your audience.

Reef Al-Jawf is a digital platform dedicated to serving the Al-Jawf region in Saudi Arabia, offering users an easy way to explore daily chalet rentals, view property details, and connect for booking. The platform also brings together recreational activities and local food and beverage services for a more comprehensive experience.

Loryfy is a digital platform that connects existing business owners and entrepreneurs with potential investors and business partners. It enables investors to discover available opportunities and communicate directly with business owners through private in-app messaging.

Tasami is a comprehensive digital platform designed to help users transform their ambitions and goals into realistic, actionable plans. The platform combines AI-powered tools, personal assistants, supportive communities, and goal-tracking features to support users throughout their journey toward achieving their goals. It includes a web platform and mobile application for an integrated user experience.

Bena'at is a specialized educational platform designed to support families throughout their journey of building a healthy family and raising conscious, well-rounded children. The app provides comprehensive educational content and courses delivered by specialists in family and parenting fields.

A comprehensive mobile application designed to serve domestic pilgrims, providing a digital companion throughout their Hajj journey. The app brings essential information, organization, and communication services together in one place, helping deliver a more convenient and seamless pilgrimage experience.
